Overview

Tauranga is a city in BOP with a population of 158,000. New Zealand’s fastest-growing city, a sunny coastal gem with beautiful beaches, the Mount Maunganui, and a booming port. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
